model: Eaton Motor Insight overload relay via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: Eaton Motor Insight (C441) motor protection overload relays with Modbus, read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the Eaton Motor Insight: 17 objects (16 AI, 1 AO), all polled. One output is the command register (relay off/reset or energize); inputs give phase and average currents and voltages, motor kW, voltage and current unbalance, PF, ground fault current, frequency, thermal capacity and the latest fault.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Motor_Insight_OL_Relay_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the maker's Modbus register document (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/AP04209001E.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
All 17 rows are flagged for polling in the profile, so every object is served to BACnet once the profile is loaded.

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.

integration.summary: Map average current, voltage and the latest fault; the command register (AO 1) switches the relay off/reset or energizes it, so write it only on purpose.

minimum_points.name: Command Register: Relay OFF_Reset/Energize Relay
minimum_points.why: Command register: relay off/reset or energize

setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
